structural.title: No contributor–institution affiliation graph
structural.detail: Neo4j has no RorOrg node for Agroscope and no AFFILIATED_WITH edges from its contributors — a "who works where" view cannot be built from the graph as it stands.

structural.title: No publication links to the Agroscope ROR
structural.detail: No publication links currently resolve from any Agroscope repository to a scholarly record (checked schema:sourceOrganization against the Agroscope ROR across the SPARQL graph, plus a full-text "agroscope" search across Zenodo and Infoscience collections — zero matches). This is an identifier-coverage gap upstream (ORCID / CITATION.cff / DOI linkage), not a dashboard limitation.
